name: CloseProfit v2
summary: CloseProfit v2 is a utility EA that automatically closes positions based on profit or loss thresholds. It monitors open positions and triggers closure when total or individual profit/loss reaches user-defined levels. This EA does not open any new positions and serves purely as a position management tool.
summary_zh: CloseProfit v2是一个工具型EA，根据盈利或亏损阈值自动平仓。它监控持仓并在总盈亏或单笔盈亏达到用户设定水平时触发平仓。该EA不开仓新头寸，纯粹作为仓位管理工具使用。
strategy_analysis: CloseProfit v2的核心策略概念是自动化盈亏管理，而非产生交易信号。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不主动开仓。出场条件基于用户设定的利润目标或止损阈值，当持仓的浮动盈亏达到预设值时自动平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及建仓逻辑，仅管理已有仓位的平仓操作。资金管理通过设置总账户盈亏阈值来间接实现，防止过度亏损或锁定既定利润。该工具支持按总盈亏或按单笔盈亏进行平仓判断，提供了灵活的风险控制手段。整体而言，这是一个辅助性风控工具，适合需要自动化止盈止损管理的交易者使用。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of CloseProfit v2 is automated profit/loss management rather than generating trading signals. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not open positions. Exit conditions are based on user-defined profit targets or loss thresholds, automatically closing positions when floating P&L reaches preset levels. For position sizing, this EA does not involve position opening logic and only manages the closing of existing positions. Money management is indirectly implemented by setting total account P&L thresholds to prevent excessive losses or lock in established profits. The tool supports closing positions based on either total P&L or individual position P&L, providing flexible risk control capabilities. Overall, this is an auxiliary risk management tool suitable for traders who need automated take-profit and stop-loss management.

parameters.name: ProfitTarget
parameters.description: 目标利润阈值，达到后自动平仓
parameters.description_en: Profit threshold for automatic position close

parameters.name: LossLimit
parameters.description: 亏损限额阈值，达到后自动平仓
parameters.description_en: Loss limit threshold for automatic position close

parameters.name: CloseAllOnProfit
parameters.description: 是否在达到利润目标时平掉所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Close all positions when profit target is reached

parameters.name: CloseAllOnLoss
parameters.description: 是否在达到亏损限额时平掉所有仓位
parameters.description_en: Close all positions when loss limit is reached

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定EA的魔术编号，0表示管理所有仓位
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

parameters.name: CheckInterval
parameters.description: 检查盈亏状态的时间间隔（毫秒）

pros: 自动化盈亏管理，减少交易者情绪干扰
支持按总盈亏和单笔盈亏双重判断，灵活性强
可配合任何策略EA使用，兼容性好
锁定利润功能帮助交易者遵守纪律
设置简单直观，参数易于理解
pros_en: Automated P&L management reduces emotional interference in trading decisions
Supports both total and per-position P&L thresholds, offering high flexibility
Compatible with any strategy EA, serving as a complementary risk management layer
Profit locking feature helps traders maintain discipline and stick to their plan
Simple and intuitive setup with easy-to-understand parameters
cons: 不产生交易信号，完全依赖其他策略开仓
在极端行情下可能无法按预期价格平仓，存在滑点风险
缺乏移动止损或动态调整止盈功能
单一时间间隔检查可能导致平仓延迟
没有考虑点差和佣金对实际盈亏的影响
cons_en: Does not generate trading signals, completely dependent on other strategies for opening positions
May fail to close at expected prices during extreme market conditions, with slippage risk
Lacks trailing stop or dynamic take-profit adjustment functionality
Single interval check may cause delays in position closure timing
Does not account for the impact of spreads and commissions on actual P&L
improvements: 增加移动止损和动态止盈功能，实现更精细的盈亏管理
加入点差和佣金的计算，使盈亏判断更准确
improvements_en: Add trailing stop and dynamic take-profit features for more refined P&L management
Include spread and commission calculations for more accurate P&L assessment

risk_points: 作为工具型EA本身无交易风险，但平仓执行可能受市场流动性影响
极端行情下滑点可能导致实际平仓价格偏离预期
risk_points_en: As a utility EA, it carries no inherent trading risk, but closure execution may be affected by market liquidity
Slippage during extreme market conditions may cause actual closure prices to deviate from expectations
